G1701.def:
ἐμ-παιγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐμπαίζω, which see), [in LXX: Eze.22:4 (קַלָּסָה), Ps 38:7 B א1 קָלָה ni.), Wis.12:2, Sir.27:28, 2Ma.7:7, 3Ma.5:22 * ;] 
a mocking: Hébreux 11:36.†

G1702.def:
ἐμ-παίζω 
[in LXX for עָלַל hithp., שָׂחַק, etc. ;] 
= Attic προσ-, καταπαίζω, 
to mock at, mock (Hdt.): with dative, Matthieu 27:29, 31, Marc 15:20, Luc 14:29 22:63 23:36; pass., Matthieu 2:16, Luc 18:32; absol., Matthieu 20:19 27:41, Marc 10:34 15:31, Luc 23:11.†

G1703.def:
ἐμ-παίκτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐμπαίζω, which see), [in LXX: Ésaïe 3:4 (תַּעֲלוּל) * ;] 
a mocker: 2 Pierre 3:3, Ju 18.†

G1704.def:
ἐν-περι-πατέω, -ῶ
(Rec. ἐμπ-, see: ἐν) [in LXX: Lévitique 26:12 Job 1:7, al. (הָלַךְ hithp.), Wis.19:21 ;] 
to walk about in or among: before ἐν., dative of person(s), 2 Corinthiens 6:16 (LXX),†

G1705.def:
ἐμ-πίπλημι
(on ἐμπίμπ-, see LS, see word, Bl., § 6, 8), and ἐμπιπλάω (Actes 14:17), [in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, שָׂבַע ;] 
to fill full, fill up, satisfy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), Luc 1:53, Actes 14:17; pass., Luc 6:25, Jean 6:12; metaphorically, with genitive of person(s), to take one's fill of: Romains 15:24 (cf. Dan LXX Su 32).†

G1706.def:
ἐμ-πίπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;] 
to fall into: before εἰς, Matthieu 12:11, Luc 6:39 10:36; metaphorically, εἰς κρίμα, 1 Timothée 3:6; ὀνειδισμόν 1 Timothée 3:7; πειρασμόν, 1 Timothée 6:9; εἰς χεῖρας θεοῦ (cf. 2 Rois 24:14, 1 Chroniques 21:13, Sir.2:18), Hébreux 10:31.†

G1707.def:
ἐμ-πλέκω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 28:18 (נָפַל), 2Ma.15:17 * ;] 
to weave in, entwine; pass., metaphorically, to be involved, entangled in: 2 Timothée 2:4, 2 Pierre 2:20.†

G1708.def:
ἐμ-πλοκή, ῆς, ἡ
(ἐμπλίκω), 
a braiding: τριχῶν, 1 Pierre 3:3.†

G1710.def:
ἐμ-πορεύομαι depon. 
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר ;] 
__1. to travel, esp. for business. 
__2. to traffc, trade: Jacques 4:13. 
__3. C. accusative of thing(s) 
__(a) to traffic in; 
__(b) to import: (Osée 12:1, for יָבַל hoph.). 
__4. C. accusative of person(s), to make a gain of: 2 Pierre 2:3.†

G1711.def:
ἐμπορία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔμπορος), [in LXX for סָחַר, רָכַל etc. ;] 
commerce, business, trade: Matthieu 22:5.†

G1712.def:
ἐμπόριον, -ον, τό
(ἔμπορος) [in LXX: Deutéronome 33:19 (סָפַן), Eze.27:3 (רָכַל); ἐ. εἶναι, Ésaïe 23:17 (זָנָה)* ;] 
a trading place, exchange: οἶκος ἐμπορίου, Jean 2:16.†

G1713.def:
ἔμ-πορος, -ου, ὁ
(πόρος, a journey), [in LXX chiefly for סָחַר, רָכַל ;] 
__1. a passenger on shipboard, one on a journey. 
__2. a merchant: Matthieu 13:45, Apocalypse 18:3, 11 18:15, 23.†

G1714.def:
ἐμ-πίπρημι, 
ἐμπρήθω (for the form, see: ἐμπίπλημι, and cf. Veitch, see word πίμπρημι), [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף ;] 
to set on fire: πόλιν, Matthieu 22:7; pass., of the body, to become inflamed: Actes 28:6 (T; πίμπρημι WH, which see).†

G1716.def:
ἐμ-πτύω 
[in LXX: before εἰς, Nombres 12:14 A, Deutéronome 25:9 (יָרָק)* ;] 
= cl., καταπτύω (Ruth., NPhr., 66), 
to spit upon: with dative, Marc 10:34 14:65 15:19; before εἰς, Matthieu 26:67 27:30. Pass., Luc 18:32.†

G1717.def:
ἐμφανής, -ές
(ἐμφαίνω, to show in, exhibit), [in LXX: Michée 4:1, Ésaïe 2:2 (כּוּן ni.), Wis.6:22 7:21 14:17; ἐ. γίνεσθαι, Exode 2:14 (יָדַע ni.), Ésaïe 65:1 (דָּרַשׁ ni.)* ;] 
manifest: Actes 10:40; metaphorically, Romains 10:20 (LXX) (see: ἐπιφανής).†

G1718.def:
ἐμφανίζω 
[in LXX for יָדַע hi., etc. ;] 
__1. to manifest, exhibit: ἐαυτόν, with dative of person(s), Jean 14:21-22 (DCG, ii, 112b). Pass. and mid., to show oneself, appear: Matthieu 27:53, Hébreux 9:24 (cf. MM, Exp., xii). 
__2. to declare, make known: before ὅτι, Hébreux 11:14; with dative of person(s), Actes 23:15; with accusative of thing(s), before πρός, Actes 23:22; κατά, with genitive of person(s), Actes 24:1 25:2; περί, Actes 25:15.†
SYN.: δηλόω, q.v

G1719.def:
ἔμ-φοβος 
[in LXX: Sir.19:24, 1Ma.13:2 * ;] 
__1. terrible. 
__2. in fear (of Godly fear, Sir.19:24), terrified: Luc 24:5, 37, Actes 10:4 24:25, Apocalypse 11:13.†

G1720.def:
ἐμ-φυσάω, -ῶ
(φυσάω, to blow), [in LXX for נָפַח, etc. ;] 
to breathe into (cf. Genèse 2:7, Wis.15:11, a1.), breathe upon: Jean 20:22.†

G1721.def:
ἔμ-φυτος, -ον
(ἐμφύω, to implant), [in LXX: ἔ. ἡ κακία αὐτῶν, Wis.12:10 * ;] 
__1. innate (Wis.12:10). 
__2. rooted, implanted: Jacques 1:21 (see Mayor, in l).†

G1723.def:
ἐν-αγκαλίζομαι
(ἀγκάλη), [in LXX for חִבֻּק pi., Proverbes 6:10 24:33 * ;] 
to take into one's arms: Marc 9:36 10:16.†

G1724.def:
ἐν-άλιος, -ον
(also -α, -ον; ἅλς, the sea), 
of the sea: τὰ ἐ., marine creatures, Jacques 3:7.†

G1725.def:
ἔν-αντι 
adv., 
a κοινή word (MM, Exp., xii), 
before; as prep., with genitive: Luc 1:8, Actes 7:10 (WH, ἐναντίον), Actes 8:21.†

G1726.def:
ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;] 
over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, Matthieu 14:24, Marc 6:48, Actes 27:4; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, Psaumes 42:1-11), with genitive, Marc 15:39. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: 1 Thessaloniciens 2:15, Actes 26:9 28:17; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., Tite 2:8. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: Luc 1:6 20:26 24:19 Actes 7:10 (ἔναντι, T), Actes 8:32 (LXX).†

G1727.def:
ἐν-αντίος, -α, -ον
(ἀντίος, set against), [in LXX: ἐξ ἐναντίας, for נֶגֶד, etc.; ἐναντίον, for פָּנִים etc. ;] 
over against, opposite, contrary: ἄνεμος, Matthieu 14:24, Marc 6:48, Actes 27:4; ἐξ ἐναντίας (ellipse obscure, see Bl., § 44,1; Mozley, Psaumes 42:1-11), with genitive, Marc 15:39. Metaphorical, opposed, hostile: 1 Thessaloniciens 2:15, Actes 26:9 28:17; ὁ ἐξ ἐ., Tite 2:8. Neuter., -ίον, adv., as prep. with genitive, before, in the presence of: Luc 1:6 20:26 24:19 Actes 7:10 (ἔναντι, T), Actes 8:32 (LXX).†

G1728.def:
ἐν-άρχομαι 
[in LXX chiefly for חָלַל hi. ;] 
to begin, make a beginning: Galates 3:3, Philippiens 1:6.†

G1729.def:
ἐνδεής, -ές
(ἐνδέω, to lack) [in LXX for חָסֵר, אֶבְיוֹן, etc. ;] 
in want, needy: Actes 4:34,†

G1730.def:
ἔν-δειγμα, -τος
(ἐνδείκνυμι), 
a plain token, proof: 2 Thessaloniciens 1:5 (cf. ἔνδειξις, which refers rather to the "act of proving"; ἔ., with the passive formation, to the thing proved, see Lft., Notes, 100; M, Th., l.with).†
SYN.: τεκμήριον

G1731.def:
ἐν-δείκνυμι 
[in LXX for לָכַד, גָּמַל, רָאָה hi. ;] 
to mark, point out. Mid„ 
__1. to show forth, prove: with accusative of thing(s), Romains 2:15 9:22, Éphésiens 2:7, Tite 2:10 3:2, Hébreux 6:11; before ἐν, with dative of person(s), Romains 9:17 (LXX), 1 Timothée 1:16; before εἰς, Hébreux 6:10 (with cogn. accusative), 2 Corinthiens 8:24. 
__2. to manifest (by act): with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), 2 Timothée 4:14 (cf. Genèse 50:15, 17, and see MM, Exp., xiii).†

G1732.def:
ἔν-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνδείκνυμι), 
a pointing out, showing forth, proof (see: ἔνδειγμα): Romains 3:25-26, 2 Corinthiens 8:24, Philippiens 1:28.†

G1733.def:
ἕν-δεκα, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl., 
eleven: of the eleven apostles, οἱ, ἕ., Matthieu 28:16, Marc 16:14, Luc 24:9, 33, Actes 1:26 2:14.†

G1735.def:
έν-δέχομαι 
[in LXX: Psaumes 119:122 (עָרַב), 2Ma.11:18 * ;] 
__1. to admit, approve. 
__2. to be possible; impers., ἑνδέχεται, it is possible: with accusative and inf., Luc 13:33 (Cremer, 687).†

G1736.def:
ἐνδημέω, -ῶ
(ἔνδημος, living in a place), 
to live in a place, be at home: ἐν τ. σώματι, 2 Corinthiens 5:6 5:9; πρὸς τ. Kύριον, 2 Corinthiens 5:8.†

G1737.def:
ἐνδιδύσκω 
[in LXX: 2 Rois 1:24 13:18, Proverbes 31:21 (לָבַשׁ), Jdth.9:1 10:3, Sir.50:11 * ;] 
to put on: with dupl. accusative, Marc 15:17 (ἐνδύουσι, Rec.). Mid., to put on oneself, be clothed in: with accusative of thing(s), Luc 16:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xii).†

G1739.def:
ἐν-δώμησις (Rec. -δόμησις), -εως, ἡ 
(δωμάω, to build), 
a build­ing in: ἡ ἐ. τ. τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, its wall had jasper built into it, Apocalypse 21:18 (see MM, Exp., xiii; Swete, Ap., l.with).†

G1740.def:
ἐν-δοξάζω 
[in LXX for כָּבַד ni., Exode 14:4, 17-18, Eze.28:22, etc.; for עָרַץ, Psaumes 89:7; Sir.38:6, al. ;] 
to glorify: pass., 2 Thessaloniciens 1:10-12.†

G1741.def:
ἔνδοξος, -ον
(δόξα [in LXX for כָּבַד, etc. ;] 
__1. held in honour, of high repute: 1 Corinthiens 4:10. 
__2. glorious, splendid: of deeds, τά ἔ., Luc 13:17; of clothing, Luc 7:25. Metaphorical, ἐκκλησία, Éphésiens 5:27 (cf. παράδοξος).†

G1742.def:
ἔνδυμα, -τος, τό
(ἐνω), [in LXX chiefly for לְבוּשׁ ;] 
raiment, clothing, a garment: Matthieu 3:4 6:25, 28 7:15 22:11-12 28:3, Luc 12:23.†

G1743.def:
ἐν-δυναμόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Juges 6:34, 1 Chroniques 12:18 A (לָבַשׁ), Psaumes 52:7 (עָזַז)* ;] 
to make strong, strengthen: with accusative, of person(s), Philippiens 4:13, 1 Timothée 1:12, 2 Timothée 4:17. Pass., Actes 9:22; C. dative, Romains 4:20; before ἐν, 2 Timothée 2:1 (ἐν Κυρίῳ), Éphésiens 6:10 (Cremer, 221).†

G1744.def:
ἐν-δύνω, see: ἐνδύω.
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2 Timothée 3:6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;] 
__1. with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 27:28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Matthieu 27:31, Marc 15:20, Luc 15:22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 6:25, Marc 6:9, Luc 8:27 12:22, Actes 12:21; ptcp., Matthieu 22:11, Marc 1:6, 2 Corinthiens 5:3, Apocalypse 1:13 15:6 19:14; of armour (figuratively): Romains 13:12, Éphésiens 6:11, 14, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:8; metaphorically, δύναμιν, Luc 24:49; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, 1 Corinthiens 15:53-54; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph 4:24, Colossiens 3:10; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Colossiens 3:12; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, Romains 13:14, Galates 3:27, 
__2. to enter, press into: 2 Timothée 3:6 (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†

G1745.def:
ἔν-δυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνδύω), [in LXX: Job 41:13 (לְבוּשׁ), Esther 5:1 * ;] 
a putting on: ίματίων, 1 Pierre 3:3.†

G1746.def:
ἐν-δύω
(ἐνδύνω, 2 Timothée 3:6), [in LXX chiefly for לָבַשׁ ;] 
__1. with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 27:28 (WH, mg., R, mg.); with dupl. accusative, Matthieu 27:31, Marc 15:20, Luc 15:22; mid., to put on oneself, be clothed with: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 6:25, Marc 6:9, Luc 8:27 12:22, Actes 12:21; ptcp., Matthieu 22:11, Marc 1:6, 2 Corinthiens 5:3, Apocalypse 1:13 15:6 19:14; of armour (figuratively): Romains 13:12, Éphésiens 6:11, 14, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:8; metaphorically, δύναμιν, Luc 24:49; ἀφθαρσίαν, ἀθανασίαν, 1 Corinthiens 15:53-54; τ. καινὸν ἄνθρωπον, Eph 4:24, Colossiens 3:10; σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, Colossiens 3:12; Ἰησ. Χριστόν, Romains 13:14, Galates 3:27, 
__2. to enter, press into: 2 Timothée 3:6 (cf. ἐπ-ενδύω).†

G1747.def:
ἐν-έδρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἕδρα, a seat), [in LXX: Josué 8:7-9, Psaumes 10:8 (אָרַב)* ;] 
a lying in wait, an ambush: Actes 23:16 (Rec. ἔνεδρον, a form frequently in LXX), Actes 25:8.†

G1748.def:
ἐνεδρεύω
(ἐνέδρα), [in LXX chiefly for אָרַב ;] 
to lie in wait for: with accusative of person(s), Luc 11:54, Actes 23:21.†

G1750.def:
ἐν-ειλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX 1 Rois 21:9 לוּט * ;] 
to roll in, wind in: with accusative of person(s) and dative of thing(s), Marc 15:46.†

G1751.def:
ἔν-ειμι 
__1. to be in, within (Job 27:3, al.): ptcp. pl., τὰ ἐνόντα, Luc 11:41 (R, txt., cf. MM, Exp., xii). 
__2. to be possible: Luc 11:41 (R, mg.).†

G1752.def:
ἕνεκα (so Matthieu 19:5, Luc 6:22, Actes 19:32 26:21; elsewhere, prop, only before a vowel, ἕνεκεν; εἵνεκεν, originally Ionic: Luc 4:18 18:29, Actes 28:20, 2 Corinthiens 3:10), 
prep. with genitive, 
on account of, because of: Matthieu 5:10-11 16:25 19:29, Marc 8:35, Luc 6:22, Actes 28:20, Romains 8:36, 2 Corinthiens 3:10; ἕ. τούτου, Matthieu 19:5; υούτων, Actes 26:21; τίνος ἕ., Actes 19:32; before τοῦ, with inf., 2 Corinthiens 7:12; οὗ ἕν., Luc 4:18

G1753.def:
ἐνέργεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐνεργής), [in LXX: Wis.7:17, 26 13:4 18:22, 2Ma.3:29, 3Ma.4:21 3Mac 5:12 3Mac 5:28 * ;] 
operative power (as distinct from δύναμις, potential power), working: of God, Éphésiens 1:19 3:7 4:16, Philippiens 3:21, Colossiens 1:29 2:12; of Satan, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:9 2:11 (cf. M, Th., l.with; AR, Eph., 241 ff.; Cremer, 261).†

G1754.def:
ἐνεργέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Nombres 8:24 B (עֲבֹדָה צָבָא), Ésaïe 41:4, Proverbes 21:6 (פָּעַל), Proverbes 31:12 (גָּמַל), I Esther 2:20, Wis.15:11 16:17 * ;] (for full lexical treatment, see AR, Eph., 243 ff.); 
__1. intrans., to be at work or in action, to operate (opposite to ἀργέω): before ἐν, with dative of person(s), Matthieu 14:2, Marc 6:14, Éphésiens 2:2; with dative of person(s), before εἰς (Lft., in l), Galates 2:8. 
__2. Trans., to work, effect, do: with accusative of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 12:11, Éphésiens 1:11; id, before ἐν, with dative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 12:6, Galates 3:5, Philippiens 2:13; ἐ. ἐνέργειαν, Éphésiens 1:19-20 Pass. (taken as mid. by Lft., Ga., 204 f.; but see AR, Eph., l.with; Milligan, Th., 28 f.; Mayor, Ja., 177 ff.), in NT, "always used of some principle or power at work" (Meyer), to be actuated, set in operation: 2 Thessaloniciens 2:7; before ἐν, Romains 7:5, 2 Corinthiens 1:6 4:12, Éphésiens 3:20, Colossiens 1:29, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:13; before διά, with genitive of thing(s), Galates 5:6; ἐνεργουμένη (M, Pr., 156), Jacques 5:16 (Cremer, 262).†

G1755.def:
ἐνέργημα, -τος, τό
(ἐνεργέω), 
effect, operation (Polyb.): pl., 1 Corinthiens 12:6 12:10 (Cremer, 262, 713).†

G1756.def:
ἐνεργής, -ές
(late form of ἐνεργός, on WH. cf. AR, Eph., 241), 
at work, active, effective: 1 Corinthiens 16:9, Phm 6, Hébreux 4:12 (Cremer, 261).†

G1757.def:
ἐν-ευλογέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ ;] 
to bless: pass., before ἐν, Actes 3:25 (LXX), Galates 3:8 (LXX) (Cremer, 770).†

G1758.def:
ἐν-έχω 
[in LXX: Genèse 49:23 (סָתַם), Eze.14:4, 7, 3Ma.6:10 * ;] 
__1. to hold in; pass., to be held, entangled: with dative of thing(s); jig., ζυγῷ δουλείας, Galates 5:1 (cf. MM, Exp., xii); θλίψρεσιν, 2 Thessaloniciens 1:4 (cf. ἀσεβείσιν, 3Mac, l.with). 
__2. to set oneself against, be urgent against (as Ge, l.with; for con­struction, see Swete, Mk., l.with): Marc 6:19, Luc 11:53.†

G1760.def:
ἐνθυμέομαι, -οῦμαι
(θυμός), [in LXX for דָּמָה pi., etc. ;] 
to reflect on, ponder: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 1:20 9:4.†

G1761.def:
ἐνθύμησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐνθυμέομαι), [in Sm.: Job 21:27, Eze.11:21 * ;] 
consideration, pondering (EV, device): Actes 17:29; pl., thoughts, feel­ings: Matthieu 9:4 12:25, Hébreux 4:12.†
SYN.: ἔννοια, the action of the reason; while ἐνθ. is rather that of the affections (cf. Westc., Heb., l.with)

G1762.def:
ἔνι Ionic form of ἐν (ἐνί), with strengthened accent; 
[in LXX: Sir.37:2, 4Ma.4:22 * ;] 
= ἔνεστι, 
is in, has place, can be: 1 Corinthiens 6:5, Galates 3:28 (tris) Colossiens 3:11, Jacques 1:17 (cf. Lft., Ga.; Hort and Mayor, Ja., ll. with).†

G1763.def:
ἐνιαυτός, -oῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX for שָׁנֶה ;] 
__1. prop., a cycle of time. 
__2. = ἔτος, a year: Jean 11:49, 51 18:13, Actes 11:26 18:11, Jacques 5:17, Apocalypse 9:15; pl., of sabbatical years, Galates 4:10; ποιεῖν ἐ., to spend a year, Jacques 4:13;ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐ., Hébreux 9:7; κατ᾽ ἐ., Hébreux 9:25 10:1, 3; ἐ. δεκτόν, Luc 4:19 (LXX).†

G1765.def:
ἐν-ισχύω 
[in LXX for חָזַק, etc. ;] 
to strengthen: in spiritual sense, Luc 22:43; pass., Actes 9:19 (Rec. ἐνισχύσεν, became strong, as in LXX, Genèse 12:10 48:2, al.).†

G1766.def:
ἐνατος, (Rec. ἔνν-), -η, -ον 
ninth: Apocalypse 21:20; of the ninth hour (3 o'clock, p.m.), Matthieu 20:5 27:45-46, Marc 15:33-34, Luc 23:44, Actes 3:1 10:3, 30.†

G1767.def:
ἐννέα, οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl., 
nine: Luc 17:17; ἐνενήκοντα ἐ., Matthieu 18:12-13, Luc 15:4, 7.†

G1768.def:
ἐννενήκοντα, see: ἐνεν-.
ἐνενήκοντα (Rec. ἐννεν-), οἱ, αἱ, τά indecl., 
ninety: Matthieu 18:12-13, Luc 15:4, 7.†

G1769.def:
ἐνεός
(Rec. ἐνν-), -οῦ, ὁ [in LXX: Ésaïe 56:10 (אִלֵּם), Ep. Jérémie 41:1-18; ἐ. ποιεῖν, Proverbes 17:28 * ;] 
dumb, speechless: Actes 9:7.†

G1770.def:
ἐν-νεύω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 6:13 10:10 (קָרַץ), Sir.27:22 A * ;] 
to nod to, make a sign to: with dative of person(s), Luc 1:62.†

G1771.def:
ἔννοια, -ας, ἡ
(νοῦς), [in LXX: Proverbes 1:4 2:11 3:21 4:1 5:2 8:12 16:22 18:15 19:7 23:4, 19 24:7 (מְזִמָּה, etc.), Wis.2:14, Da TH Sus 1:28* ;] 
__1. thinking, consideration. 
__2. a thought, purpose, design: Hébreux 4:12, 1 Pierre 4:1.†
SYN.: ἐνθῦμησις, which see (Cremer, 439)

G1772.def:
ἔν-νομος, -ον 
[in LXX: Sir, Proverbes 1:1-33 ogue 12* ;] 
__1. lawful, legal (MM, Exp., xiii): Actes 19:39. 
__2. Of persons, 
__(a) law-abiding; 
__(b) under law: ἔ. Χριστοῦ, in relation to Christ, 1 Corinthiens 9:21 (Cremer. 435).†

G1773.def:
ἔννυχος, -ον
(νύξ), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:5 * ;] (in cl. poët.; prose in late Gk. only) 
nightly. Neut., adverbially, ἔννυχα (Rec. -χον), by night: Marc 1:35.†

G1774.def:
ἐν-οικέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly (29/36) for יָשַׁב ;] 
to dwell in; metaphorically, before ἐν, with dative of person(s): ὁ θεός, 2 Corinthiens 6:16; τ. πνεῦμα, Romains 8:11, 2 Timothée 1:14; ὁ λόγος, Colossiens 3:16; πίστις, 2 Timothée 1:5; ἁμαρτία, Romains 7:17.†

G1776.def:
ἐν-οχλέω, -ῶ
(ὄχλος), [in LXX for חָלָה ;] 
to trouble: with accusative, Hébreux 12:15. Pass., before ἀπό, Luc 6:18.†

G1777.def:
ἔνοχος, -ον (= ἐνεχόμενος), 
(in LXX for רָשַׁע hi., etc. ;] 
__1. held in, bound by: with genitive (cl. with dative), δουλείας, Hébreux 2:15. 
__2. In law-phrases 
__(a) liable to a charge or action (cl. with dative, of crime): with dative, of the tribunal (MM, Exp., xiii), Matthieu 5:21-22; before εἰς (Field, Notes, 4 f.), Matthieu 5:22 
__(b) with genitive, of the punishment (Genèse 26:11): θανάτου, Matthieu 26:66, Marc 14:64; 
__(with) with genitive (cl. with dative„ rarely with prep.; MM, Exp., xiii), of the crime (2Ma.13:6): Marc 3:29; 
__(d) with genitive, of the thing injured, guilty (absol., in Cl.): 1 Corinthiens 11:27, Jacques 2:10 (cf. Ésaïe 54:17; DB, ii, 268a).†

G1778.def:
ἔνταλμα, -τος, τό
(ἐντέλλω), [in LXX: Job 23:11 (אָשֻׁר) Job 23:12, Ésaïe 29:13 (מִצְוָה), Ésaïe 55:11 (aliter in Heb.)* ;] 
a precept: pl., Matthieu 15:9 (LXX), Marc 7:7, Colossiens 2:22.†

G1779.def:
ἐνταφιάζω 
[in LXX: Genèse 50:2 (חָנַט; cf. ἐνταφιαστής, Genèse 50:2 for רָפָא; see Deiss., BS, 120 f.; MM, Exp., xiii)* ;] 
a κοινή word (Deiss., LAE, 723), 
to prepare for burial: Matthieu 26:12, Jean 19:40.†

G1780.def:
ἐνταφιασμός, -οῦ
(ἐνταφιάζω), 
preparation for burial: Marc 14:8, Jean 12:7.†

G1781.def:
ἐν-τέλλω 
[in LXX, as in NT (and mostly in Hdt.), always mid., chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;] 
-ομαι, to command, enjoin, instruct: before περί Hébreux 11:22; with inf., Matthieu 19:7; with dative of person(s), Actes 1:2; οὕτως, Actes 13:47; καθώς, Jean 14:31 (ἐντολὴν ἔδωκεν, WH); before λέγων, Matthieu 17:9; with inf., Jean 8:5; ἵνα, Marc 13:34; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 28:20, Marc 10:3, Jean 15:14, 17; before περί, with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 4:6 and Luc 4:10 (LXX); διαθήκην ἐ. πρός, with accusative of person(s), Hébreux 9:20 (LXX) (cf. Sir.45:3).†
SYN.: 
κελεύω, to command, of verbal orders in general; 
παραγγέλλω, to charge, esp. of the transmitted orders of a military com­mander; ἐντέλλω points rather to the contents of the command (see Thayer, see word κελεύω)

G1782.def:
ἐντεῦθεν 
adv. (ἔνθεν), [in LXX chiefly for זֶה ;] 
__1. of place, hence: Luc 4:9 13:31, Jean 2:16 7:3 14:31 18:36; ἐ. καὶ ἐ. (for cl. ἔνθεν κ. ἔνθεν), on this side and on that, on each side, Jean 19:18; similarly, ἐ. καὶ ἐκεῖθεν, Apocalypse 22:2. 
__2. Of time, thereupon. 
__3. Causal; hence, therefore: Jacques 4:1.†
ἔνθεν, 
adv., [in LXX for זֶה, פֹּה, etc. ;] 
hence: Matthieu 17:20, Luc 16:26.†

G1783.def:
ἐν-τευξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐντυγχάνω, which see), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:3 * ;] 
__1. a lighting upon, meeting with. 
__2. conversation. 
__3. a petition (in this sense common in π.; cf. Deiss., BS, 121 f., 146; MM, Exp., iii): 1 Timothée 4:5; p1., 1 Timothée 2:1.†
SYN.: δέησις (which see)

G1784.def:
ἔντιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX for חוֹר, etc. ;] 
honoured, prized, precious: of persons, Luc 7:2, Philippiens 2:29; compar., Luc 14:8; of things, metaphorically, λίθος, 1 Pierre 2:4 2:6" (LXX) .†

G1786.def:
ἐντόπιος, -ον
(τόπος), 
of a place, resident: Actes 21:12.†

G1787.def:
ἐντός
(ἐν), 
adv., [in LXX: Job 18:20, Psaumes 39:3 109:22, Cantique des cantiques 3:10; ὁ, τὸ, τὰ ἐ., Psaumes 103:1, Ésaïe 16:11, Da TH Daniel 10:16, Sir.19:26, 1Ma.4:48 * ;] 
within: with genitive, ἐ. ὑμῶν, within you (i.e. in your hearts, R, txt.), or among you (R, mg.), Luc 17:21 (cf. Field, Notes, 71; Thayer, see word; ICC, Lk, l.with; Dalman, Words, 145 ff.); τὸ ἐ., Matthieu 23:26.†

G1788.def:
ἐν-τρέπω 
[in LXX for כָּנַע ni., כָּלַם ni., etc. ;] 
to turn about; metaphorically, put to shame: with accusative, 1 Corinthiens 4:14; pass., 2 Thessaloniciens 3:14, Tite 2:8; mid., to reverence: with accusative of person(s) (cl. with genitive), Matthieu 21:37, Marc 12:6, Luc 18:2, 4 20:13, Hébreux 12:9 (cf. MM, Exp., iii, xiii).†

G1789.def:
ἐν-τρέφω 
to train up, nurture; pass., metaphorically, τοῖς λόγοις τ. πίστεως, 1 Timothée 4:6.†

G1790.def:
ἔν-τρομος, -ον 
[in LXX: Da TH Daniel 10:11 (רָעַד hi.); ἔ. γίγνεσθαι, Psaumes 18:7 77:18 (רַעַשׁ), Wis.17:10, 1Ma.13:2 * ;] 
trembling with fear (Pint.): Actes 7:32 16:29, Hébreux 12:21 (ἔκτρ-, WH, mg.).†

G1791.def:
ἐν-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX: Job 20:3, Psaumes 35:26 44:15 69:7, 19 71:13 109:29 (כְּלִמָּה)* ;] 
__1. with genitive of person(s), respect, reverence (Soph., Polyb., al.). 
__2. Absol., shame (Hipp.): 1 Corinthiens 6:5 15:34.†

G1792.def:
ἐν-τρυφάω, ῶ
[in LXX: Ésaïe 55:2 57:4 (עָנַג hith.), Habacuc 1:10 (קָלַס hith.), 4Ma.8:8, etc. ;] 
to revel in: ἐν-τ. ἀπάταις, 2 Pierre 2:13 (see Mayor, in l).†

G1793.def:
ἐν-τυγχάνω 
[in LXX: Da TH Daniel 6:12-13 (קֶרֶב) Wis.8:20 16:28, 2Ma.2:25 2Mac 4:36 2Mac 6:12 2Mac 15:39, 3Ma.6:37; before κατά, 1Ma.8:32 1Mac 10:61-64 1Mac 11:25 * ;] 
__1. to fall in with. 
__2. to meet with in order to converse. 
__3. to petition, make petition: with dative of person(s), before ὑπέρ with genitive of person(s), Actes 25:24 (cf. Field, Notes, 140), Hébreux 7:25, Romains 8:27, 34 (θεῷ, not expressed); before κατά, against: Romains 11:2 (cf. ἔντευξις, ὑπερ-εντυγχάνω).†

G1794.def:
ἐν-τυλίσσω 
to wrap up (LS), roll or coil about (DCG, ii, 227, 507a): with accusative and dative, Matthieu 27:59 (iv, Tr. [WH], cf. similar sentence in π.; MM, Exp., xiii), Luc 23:53; pass., Jean 20:7.†

G1795.def:
ἐν-τυπόω, -ῶ
(τύπος), [in LXX for פִּתּוּחַ, Exode 39:30) A * ;] 
to imprint, engrave: pass. ptcp., with dative, 2 Corinthiens 3:7.†

G1796.def:
ἐν-υβρίζω 
[in OT (Al.), Lévitique 24:11 * ;] 
to insult, mock at: Hébreux 10:29.†

G1797.def:
ἐνυπνιάζω
(ἐνύπνιον), [in LXX, as in NT, -ομαι, depon., chiefly for חָלַם ;] 
to dream: ἐνυπνίοις ἐ., Actes 2:17 (LXX); present ptcp., Ju 8.†

G1798.def:
ἐνύπνιον, -ου, τό
(ὕπνος), [in LXX chiefly for חֲלוֹם ;] 
a dream: pl., Actes 2:17.†

G1799.def:
ἐνώπιος, -ον
(ὤψ), [in LXX for פָּנִים, etc. ;] 
face to face, in sight (Theocr.; ἄρτοι ἐ., Exode 25:29): neut., ἐνώπιον, in vernacular, with force of prep. with genitive [in LXX for פָּנִים, עַיִן, etc., cf. Dalman, Words, 31 f., 209 f., and Deiss., BS., 213], in NT, most frequently in Lk, Ac, Re, never in Mt, Mk, before, in the presence of: Luc 1:19 Luc 4:7, Actes 4:10 Actes 6:5, Apocalypse 1:4 2:14, al.; esp. ἐ. Κυρίου (θεοῦ), in the sight of God, or with God as witness or as judge, Romains 14:22, 1 Corinthiens 1:29, 1 Timothée 2:3, Jacques 4:10, 1 Pierre 3:4, al.
